title: Kodak Just Made a Photo Keychain That's a TRACKER 🤯
description:
Kodak just made a keychain that shows your photos — and finds your keys. 🤯

The Kodak SlideTag (made by Reto, the company behind the Kodak Charmera) is a $34.99 keychain shaped like an old 35mm film slide. It has a 1.54-inch six-colour E Ink screen (240×240) that holds up to 12 photos, works with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub, reaches up to 30 m over Bluetooth 5.4, and uses a coin-cell battery you can swap yourself.

The catch: it's sold in blind boxes (8 designs + a secret 9th), so you don't pick your design — and there's no ultra-wideband, so it's less precise than an AirTag.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 68/100 → SPEC, if photos matter more than precise finding.
